The '''H'raka Forest''' was a fictional location that appeared in a story that [[Wim]] read on his [[storypad]]. The tale was written in [[Aurebesh]] and went:<ref name="Real Adventure" />
<center><poem>[[Druin|DRUIN]] PACKED HIS BAG WITH EVERYTHING <small>''[obscured]''</small>
MIGHT NEED AND SET OFF ON HIS ADVENTU<small>''[obscured]''</small>

THE H'RAKA FOREST WAS BEAUTIFUL, WITH TALL [[Tree|TREES]] AND BR-
IGHT [[Color|COLORFUL]] [[Plant|FLOWERS]]. DRUIN FELT [[The Force|THE FORCE]] FLOWING THROU-
GH EVERYTHING AROUND HIM. FIRST DRUIN CAME ACROSS THE RUINED 
HUT OF A WOODCHOPPER

THE PLACE HAD BEEN AB-
ANDONED. THE [[Axe|AX]] LEFT BE-
HIND; CLEFT INTO THE STU-
MP OF AN OLD TREE. 

THE VINES OF THE [[Forest|FORE-
ST]] HAD GROWN BACK AND 
OVERWHELMED EVERYTHING

NEXT DRUIN CAME ACROSS THE PADDOCK OF A HERDER TH<small>''[illegible]''</small>
WAS LONG GONE. RUN OFF INTO THE FOREST OR EATEN BY
BEAST <small>''[sic]''</small>. BUT FROM THEIR OLD [[Foodstuff|FOOD]] TROUGH GREW 
A STRANGE <small>''[illegible]''</small>
BEAUTIFUL FLOWER.

FINALLY, DRUIN FELT A STRONG PRESENCE IN THE FORCE. [[Gender|HE]] <small>''[illegible; presumably "K-"]''</small>
NEW HE WAS GETTING CLOSE TO THE FEARSOME [[Rancor|BEAST]] 

HE TOOK OUT HIS 
[[Lightsaber|LIGHTSABER]] AND 
HELD IT READY 
AS THE BEAST
LUNGED OUT OF 
THE FOREST AND 
LOOMED OVER HIM.</poem></center>
